title: Experiment manifest
description: Links the runs that actually executed for one experiment (e.g. an RQ4 ablation) to their aggregated results. Statistical significance is computed at THIS level, over many runs, never inside a single run.

matrix.description: Reference to the experiments/matrices file that defined the run set.

runs.description: run_id values that belong to this experiment. Optional in the immutable manifest: membership grows while the experiment executes and is owned by the mutable run-index.json.
